$comment: Recorded cases for the episode map (backend/src/account/episode_map_rules.rs), captured by scanning Kitsu's catalogue against both trackers. Every reported tracker mismatch becomes a case here (docs/testing.md). wire/ holds the bodies the readers are checked against.

anilist.json.request: Kitsu's whole catalogue (GET /anime?sort=id&include=mappings, 22,504 entries) against AniList (Page { media(idMal_in / id_in) } with relations, then streamingEpisodes for every longer entry) — one case per Kitsu entry whose count the AniList entry the app resolves it to disagrees with, plus each later Kitsu part of a split; Kitsu's media-relationships for each, two hops out.
anilist.json.notes: Each case: id, kitsu_title, scan_class (the shape the scan classified: A, A-relaxed, A-claimed, B, B?, B', D, D-ambiguous, E, U), the evidence as the app's readers return it, the shape the documented rules answer (expect), and a note where the case is pinned or the scan and the app part ways.

mal.json.request: Kitsu's whole catalogue against MyAnimeList (GET /v2/anime/ranking?ranking_type=all|bypopularity&fields=num_episodes,start_date,end_date,media_type,status, then GET /v2/anime/{id}?fields=…,related_anime for every mismatch and its sequels) — one case per Kitsu entry whose count the MyAnimeList entry disagrees with, plus each later Kitsu part of a split.
mal.json.notes: Same shape as anilist.json; MyAnimeList carries no episode list the app reads, so no case lists one.
